To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we identified new sources of resistance to anthracnose of lentil caused by the fungal disease Colletotrichurn truncatum race Ct1 and Ct0 in Lens culinarus Medikus sub. culinarus obtained by single plant screening in germplasm collections.

1) 4.0 % of the tested germplasm lines were resistant to Colletotricum truncatum, and 2) 2.6 % of the lines were resistant to the race Ct1, 1.2 % of the accessions were resistant to race Ct0 and 0.2 % were resistant to both races

(a) resistance to anthracnose was obtained in 23 L. culinar is accessions by single plant selection, (b) the resistance was stable over two generations, (c) the resistance is controlled by a single recessive gene in 13 accessions, (d) the resistance is conditioned by two or three genes in 10 accessions, and (e) resistance was obtained for both races Ct0 and Ct 1 and for the two races combined
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification and characterization of new sources of resistance to anthracnose of lentil caused by the fungus Colletotrichium truncatum.
the identification of new sources of resistance to C. truncatrum in lentil and with the establishment of a collection of lentil germplasm access with resistance to the disease.
the identification of new sources of resistance to C. truncatrum races Ct0 and Ct 1 in germplasm collections of Lens culinaris.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
resistance to anthracnose was obtained in 4.0 % of the accessions by single plant selection.

the resistance to race Ct-1 was obtained by selection in 15 lines from 23 accessions, resistance to race Ct 0 was obtained by selection from seven accessions and the resistance to both races was obtained by selection of one accession.
the resistance of the 15 lines to race Ct1 is stable, but that the resistance of 7 lines to race Ct0 is stable in some lines but not in others.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
single plant selection is an effective method to generate new sources of resistance in lentil germplasm to C. truncum race Ct0 as a single race or combined with race Ct1.
resistance to C. truncum race Ct0 is rare in the germplasm, and that resistance to race Ct 1 is more prevalent, and that resistance can be obtained by single plant selections.
resistance to anthracnose is present in the germplasm of L. culinarus subsp. cultinaris, and can be found in landraces from many countries.
The main takeaway from our work is that
single plant selection can be used to generate new sources of resistance in L. culinaris.
single plant selection is an effective strategy for obtaining resistance to C. truncum race Ct0 and to both races Ct0 and Ct 1.
resistance in lentil to C. truncum race Ct1 is widespread and can be obtained by single plant selections in a large number of landraces.
